HowItWorks.subtitle: How It Works
HowItWorks.title: Your Journey in 4 Simple Steps
HowItWorks.description: We've made booking a Mathura Vrindavan tour as easy as possible so you can focus on what matters — your spiritual experience.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Browse our curated tour packages — 1 day to 8 days. Filter by car type, duration, and budget. Everything is clearly priced, no hidden charges.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Fill in your travel details, select add-ons like hotel help or a local guide. Pay securely online or choose to pay on arrival.

WhyChooseUs.subtitle: Why Choose Us
WhyChooseUs.title: The Most Trusted Tour Partner in Braj
WhyChooseUs.description: Thousands of devotees have trusted us with their most sacred journeys. Here's what makes us different.
WhyChooseUs.f1Desc: Choose from Swift, Eeco, Ertiga, Innova and more — all AC, GPS-equipped, well-maintained vehicles with experienced drivers.
WhyChooseUs.f2Desc: What you see is what you pay. No hidden charges, no surprises. All-inclusive pricing from ₹2,000 onwards.
WhyChooseUs.f3Desc: Our drivers and guides are born and raised in Braj. They know every temple story, every shortcut, every aarti timing.
WhyChooseUs.f4Desc: Need a place to stay or eat? We help you find the best pure-veg restaurants and budget-to-premium hotels in Mathura & Vrindavan.
WhyChooseUs.f5Desc: Our team is always available on call and WhatsApp. Any issue during your trip — we solve it immediately.
WhyChooseUs.f6Desc: All our drivers are police-verified, licensed, and trained in safe driving. Your safety is our highest priority.
WhyChooseUs.f7Desc: We help arrange special pujas, Yamuna aarti participation, temple VIP passes, and spiritual guide services.
WhyChooseUs.f8Desc: Plans changed? Cancel up to 24 hours before your trip for a full refund. No questions asked.

mustTry.pedaDesc: Famous milk-based sweet — the most iconic souvenir
mustTry.makhanDesc: Fresh butter with sugar crystals — Krishna's favourite
mustTry.lassiDesc: Thick, creamy yogurt drink — best in the Braj region
mustTry.kachoriDesc: Crispy kachori with spiced potato curry for breakfast
mustTry.panchamritDesc: Sacred mixture of milk, curd, honey, ghee and sugar
mustTry.dalBaatiDesc: Rajasthani classic widely available in Braj dhabas

RestaurantsPage.directionsGreeting: Namaste! Can you help me find {name} in {city}? 🙏
RestaurantsPage.tip1: All food in Mathura & Vrindavan is 100% vegetarian — you will not find meat or eggs anywhere.
RestaurantsPage.tip2: Eat a hearty breakfast before morning darshan — most temples have long queues and you need energy.
RestaurantsPage.tip3: Try the prasadam distributed at temples — it is free, blessed, and delicious.
RestaurantsPage.tip4: Mathura Peda makes a perfect gift — buy from trusted shops near Holi Gate for authentic flavour.
RestaurantsPage.tip5: Carry water and light snacks if doing the Govardhan Parikrama (21 km walk).
RestaurantsPage.tip6: Most dhabas are busiest 12-2 PM and 7-9 PM. Visit slightly off-peak for faster service.

AboutPage.heroTitle: Born in Braj, Serving with Love
AboutPage.heroPara1: Mathura Vrindavan Dham Yatra was founded in 2018 by a local family that has lived in the shadow of Krishna's temples their entire lives. What began as a single taxi helping pilgrims reach Banke Bihari Temple has grown into a trusted pilgrimage travel service — but our values have never changed.
AboutPage.heroPara2: We are not just a travel company. We are devotees ourselves. Every driver on our team knows the significance of each temple, the timing of every aarti, and the story behind every sacred site in Braj Bhoomi.
AboutPage.missionTitle: Making Every Pilgrimage Peaceful, Safe & Memorable
AboutPage.missionDesc: We believe every devotee deserves a smooth, comfortable, and spiritually fulfilling journey to the holy land of Braj. Whether you are a first-time visitor or a seasoned pilgrim, we handle every detail — from your pickup to your return — so you can focus entirely on your darshan and devotion.
AboutPage.trustTitle: The Mathura Vrindavan Dham Yatra Promise
AboutPage.quote: Our goal is simple — every pilgrim who travels with us should feel like they are being looked after by a family member who loves this sacred land as much as they do.
